dominant: jñāna with adbhuta weight (knowledge as enumeration; wonder at alphabet-cosmos)
sthayibhava: prasaṅkhyāna (counting) opening into camatkāra at the vowel arithmetic
justification: The ahnika counts — spokes, goddesses, holders, vowels, kalās — and each count lands as knowledge; wonder breaks through at the triad-to-infinity ladder (v22-24) and the mouth-taught repose (v31).
